absolute_budget_grid.high_tail_role: supplement/threshold bracketing only; not a common cross-family robustness ranking

artifacts.resume: verify all locks and artifact SHAs before skip; never overwrite verified completed cells

attack_generator.objective: full fixed 256-image reference mean cross-entropy ascent

damage_matched.bracket_rule: ascending epsilon; first adjacent pair that brackets target damage; exact hit allowed
damage_matched.cross_family_eligibility: target may be called common damage-matched only if bracketed for all 4 PE x 6 seeds
damage_matched.damage_definition_pp: clean full-validation accuracy minus attacked full-validation accuracy
damage_matched.interpolation: piecewise linear in damage between observed bracket endpoints; same weight applied to epsilon, mean ADS, L4 ADS, 12-layer profile, and per-image ADS arrays
damage_matched.multiple_crossings: use first crossing / smallest epsilon bracket and record nonmonotonicity

execution_order: corrected comparison n=6 if pilot passes

runtime.gpu_cache_policy: decode/transform full validation once; cache on GPU once; derive fixed 256-image reference view from same cache

statistics.primary_contrast: within-seed damage-matched ADS differences at 5 pp
statistics.reporting: per-seed values + mean difference + 95% t-CI + exact two-sided sign test; multiplicity adjustment decided only for the final prespecified table family, not by post-hoc significance filtering
statistics.seed_aggregation: mean and sample SD over n=6
